Are you excited about building with AI beyond just prompting? Do you enjoy experimenting with the latest AI models, agent frameworks, and automation tools to solve real business problems?

title: Product Strategy & Automations Specialist, Multi-Asset Strategies & Solutions (MASS), Associate
description:
**About This Role**
**About this role**
The MASS Income team is an established business responsible for managing more than $29bn in income-oriented model portfolios and funds globally with a robust commercial pipeline. The Team is currently seeking a motivated individual to help position the platform to support long-term growth. The ideal candidate will possess a combination of technological expertise, market and industry knowledge, and will be driven to deliver exceptional results. The individual should be able to translate business needs into structured requirements for technology enhancement or automation initiatives. They should also demonstrate familiarity with leveraging AI tools and Python to enhance productivity, streamline workflows, and support scalable solutions. We are seeking an individual who can work collaboratively with cross-functional teams and partners. The candidate should deeply understand markets, customer needs, and the competitive landscape. They must show the ability to explain how MASS Income’s strategies stand out in the market. The team is seeking someone with a desire to go above and beyond to improve processes, systems, and services to help drive commercial growth.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Leverage technology, AI and Python to develop scalable tools, automate workflows, and enhance client content and investment analytics
* Build tools and visualizations to better present data and analytics to clients
* Collaborate closely with senior investors, sales & distribution, marketing, legal and other internal stakeholders
* Maintain up-to-date knowledge of industry trends, customer needs, and competitive landscape to inform product strategy decisions and drive the product roadmap
* Support all aspects of commercial growth, including developing marketing materials and completing RFPs
* Perform regular quality control of external facing content and help trouble shoot issues as they arise

**Key Qualifications**

* 3-6 years of investment industry/relevant experience
* Proficiency in using AI tools and Python (e.g., large language models, copilots, or automation platforms) to enhance productivity and problem-solving
* Hands-on experience building, customising, or deploying AI-enabled tools, workflows, or prototypes (e.g., prompt engineering, APIs, no-code/low-code platforms) is highly desirable
* Familiarity with data visualization platforms (Tableau, Power BI, or similar) to support insight generation and decision‑making
* Comfort learning and adopting new technologies quickly, with a proven ability to evaluate tools for scalability and business impact
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills with an ability to synthesize and articulate complex issues and ideas
* Proficiency with Microsoft Office (PPT, Excel) and experience working with technical concepts and analytical tools. Exposure to BlackRock’s Aladdin tools is a plus (Explore, ATX, PRT, others)
* Meticulous attention to detail, and superb organizational and time management skills
* Self-starter with strong analytical and problem-solving skills

**Our Benefits**
To help you stay energized, engaged and inspired, we offer a wide range of benefits including a strong retirement plan, tuition reimbursement, comprehensive healthcare, support for working parents and Flexible Time Off (FTO) so you can relax, recharge and be there for the people you care about.
  
  
**Our hybrid work model**
BlackRock’s hybrid work model is designed to enable a culture of collaboration and apprenticeship that enriches the experience of our employees, while supporting flexibility for all. Employees are currently required to work at least 4 days in the office per week, with the flexibility to work from home 1 day a week. Some business groups may require more time in the office due to their roles and responsibilities. We remain focused on increasing the impactful moments that arise when we work together in person – aligned with our commitment to performance and innovation. As a new joiner, you can count on this hybrid model to accelerate your learning and onboarding experience here at BlackRock.
  
  
**Guidance on AI use for candidates**
At BlackRock, AI has long been part of how we work – enhancing decision-making, improving operations, and helping us deliver better outcomes for clients. We encourage candidates to use AI thoughtfully to learn, prepare, and work more effectively; but during our interview process, we want to focus on getting to know you through your own experiences, thinking, and judgment. To support you, we’ve provided
**guidance**
on when and how to use AI during our hiring process so you can approach each step with confidence and showcase your best self.
  
  
**About BlackRock**
At BlackRock, we are all connected by one mission: to help more and more people experience financial well-being. Our clients, and the people they serve, are saving for retirement, paying for their children’s educations, buying homes and starting businesses. Their investments also help to strengthen the global economy: support businesses small and large; finance infrastructure projects that connect and power cities; and facilitate innovations that drive progress.
  
  
This mission would not be possible without our smartest investment – the one we make in our employees. It’s why we’re dedicated to creating an environment where our colleagues feel welcomed, valued and supported with networks, benefits and development opportunities to help them thrive.
  
  
To learn more about BlackRock, please visit Careers.BlackRock.com. We also encourage you to get to know us on LinkedIn, Instagram, YouTube, X, and TikTok.
  
  
BlackRock is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer. We evaluate qualified applicants without regard to age, disability, family status, gender identity, race, religion, sex, sexual orientation and other protected attributes at law.

title: AI Product Builder
description:
Location: Andheri, Mumbai

**About BOMBAYDC**

BOMBAYDC is a strategic digital platform firm helping enterprises build intelligent digital platforms that increase adoption, retention and revenue.

We work at the intersection of strategy, product, design, technology and AI to turn complex business problems into products people actually use.

**The Opportunity**

We're looking for an AI Product Builder who can take a product from client requirement to working prototype.

This is not a traditional Product Manager, Designer or Developer role. You’ll operate across all three — understanding the problem, defining the product, designing the experience and using AI-native tools to rapidly build and prototype the solution.

You should be comfortable taking an idea from “Here’s the problem” → “Here’s what we should build” → “Here’s the working prototype.”

**What You'll Do**

• Understand client requirements, business goals and user problems

• Translate ambiguous requirements into clear product concepts and user flows

• Define product scope, features and MVPs

• Design intuitive UX/UI and product experiences

• Use AI and no/low-code tools to rapidly build functional prototypes

• Work with engineers and designers to take concepts further

• Manage the project end-to-end — from discovery to prototype delivery

• Present ideas and prototypes to clients and incorporate feedback quickly

• Make smart trade-offs between user experience, business requirements and technical feasibility

• Use AI tools extensively across research, ideation, design, development and documentation

**You'll Probably Enjoy This Role If You Have**

• Strong product thinking with good UX/UI fundamentals

• Experience taking products from problem definition to prototype

• A builder mindset — you like making things, not just documenting them

• Comfort working directly with clients and senior stakeholders

• Ability to independently manage projects and coordinate designers and developers

• Strong understanding of modern AI tools and AI-native product development

• Ability to quickly learn new tools and technologies

• Strong communication, ownership and execution skills

• Curiosity about how AI is changing the way products are built

Experience across B2B SaaS, Banking, FinTech, Enterprise Platforms, Commerce or AI products is valuable.

**Success In This Role**

Within 3–6 months, you should be able to independently take a client problem, define the right product direction and deliver a high-quality working prototype.

Over time, we expect you to become someone who can own entire product initiatives — from client conversation to shipped experience.

**What You'll Get**

• Opportunity to work on complex enterprise products

• Direct exposure to clients, founders and senior leadership

• Freedom to experiment with AI-native tools and workflows

• Ownership from problem definition to product delivery

• One remote working day every week

• Extended year-end winter break of 7 days

• Clear growth opportunities as the company scales

**Our Culture**

We're a fairly ambitious company and we care deeply about the quality of our work.

We don't believe in working long hours for the sake of it, but we do believe in ownership and doing what's required to deliver great outcomes.

People here get a lot of responsibility very early. We value curiosity, independent thinking, attention to detail and a desire to continuously improve.

We're not a highly process-heavy or layered organization.

We expect people to ask good questions, challenge assumptions and keep raising the bar for themselves and the team.

We welcome people who are excited about building for the new world with AI. We move very fast. You should too.

If you enjoy moving between product, design, technology, AI and client conversations — and want to build real products rather than just manage them — you'll probably enjoy this role.

Apply through LinkedIn or drop an email to work@bombaydc.com with your resume and portfolio.

title: Platform Engineer
description:
At Dow, we believe in putting people first and we’re passionate about delivering integrity, respect and safety to our customers, our employees and the planet.
  
  
Our people are at the heart of our solutions. They reflect the communities we live in and the world where we do business. Their diversity is our strength. We’re a community of relentless problem solvers that offers the daily opportunity to contribute with your perspective, transform industries and shape the future. Our purpose is simple - to deliver a sustainable future for the world through science and collaboration. If you’re looking for a challenge and meaningful role, you’re in the right place.
  
  
**About You And This Role**
DOW has an exciting and challenging opportunity for an
**Azure Data Platform Engineer**
**on the Enterprise Data & Analytics Data Platform**
team.
**This is a position within our Enterprise Data & Analytics Organization.**
The role will align to Dow's Design your Day approach and allows employees to work remotely but will also require onsite work based on project work and role needs. The selected candidate will be expected to live a commutable distance from our IT Hub in Mumbai (IN) at a frequency to be agreed upon by the employee and their leader.  As an
**Azure Data Platform Engineer**
specializing in data and analytics solutions, you will be responsible for designing, implementing, and maintaining data platforms and analytics solutions on the Azure cloud platform to enable business objectives and accelerate Dow's digital transformation. Your primary focus will be on managing and organizing data within Databricks Unity Catalog, which is a centralized metadata repository for storing and discovering data assets in an organization. You will develop and implement data integration processes, data pipelines, and data transformation workflows using Databricks Unity Catalog. You will be using Azure DevOps, PowerShell, Python, and Azure Cloud resources along with implementing complete CI/CD pipelines. The Azure Data Platform Engineer will work with a cross-functional team that includes Data Engineers, Analytics Engineers, and Machine Learning Engineers.
  
  
**Responsibilities**

  
  

* Design, deploy, and maintain Azure cloud infrastructure and data platform services, including Databricks, Storage Accounts, V-Net/Networking, SQL Servers, Function Apps, and API Management.
* Develop and maintain Infrastructure as Code (IaC) using Terraform and Bicep, enabling standardized and repeatable deployments across Development, Test, and Production environments.
* Build and maintain CI/CD pipelines using Azure DevOps, including Git repositories, branching strategies, release processes, and automated deployments.
* Support the configuration, administration, and operational management of Azure Databricks and associated platform components, including Unity Catalog and integration with Azure services.
* Develop automation and operational solutions using PowerShell, with working knowledge of Python and SQL for platform administration, deployment, and troubleshooting.
* Collaborate with data engineering, application, architecture, networking, and security teams to design and implement secure, scalable, and reliable cloud-based solutions.
* Implement DevOps, cloud security, configuration management, and change management best practices, ensuring solutions align with company IT architecture and security standards.
* Continuously improve platform automation, reusable IaC libraries, technical documentation, operational procedures, and engineering best practices, while providing technical guidance to team members and stakeholders.

**Qualifications**

* Ability to thrive in challenging situations and solve complex problems.
* Manage own work effort in multiple projects with little supervision.
* Interested about emerging technologies with the ability to quickly learn and exploit cutting edge offerings to achieve business objectives.
* Excellent problem-solving and analytical skills.
* Strong communication and collaboration skills.
* A minimum of a bachelor's degree in IT discipline or a minimum of 5 years of relevant experience.
* Recent experience designing and deploying in Microsoft Azure’s Environment.

**Preferred Skills**

* DevOps Tools: Git, Azure DevOps Pipelines (Docker, Kubernetes optional)
* Infrastructure as Code: Terraform, Bicep
* Coding & Scripting: PowerShell (Python and SQL basics)
* Cloud: Azure
* Azure Services: Databricks, Databricks Workspace, V-Net, Networking, Azure SQL Server, Function Apps, Storage Accounts, API Management
* Databricks: Unity Catalog, Databricks platform concepts
* DevOps Practices: CI/CD, repository structure, branching strategy, deployment automation
* Security & Governance: Cloud security, DevOps security, Change Management, Configuration Management

Good to have skills -
  
  

* Data Governance: Microsoft Purview, Databricks Unity Catalog
* Programming & Data: Basic Python, SQL, and Apache Spark knowledge
* Containerization & Security: Docker, Kubernetes, Azure/DevOps security and governance concepts

**Additional Notes**

* Relocation assistance is not available with this position.

**Benefits – What Dow Offers You**
We invest in you.
  
  
Dow invests in total rewards programs to help you manage all aspects of you: your pay, your health, your life, your future, and your career. You bring your background, talent, and perspective to work every day. Dow rewards that commitment by investing in your total wellbeing.

description:
Marsh is seeking a talented individual to join our IT team as an AI Native Intern. This role is based in Pune. This is a hybrid role with a requirement of working at least three days a week in the office.
  
  
**Designation: Engineer**
IT application team is an in-house application development and support team for a suite of applications used by the Insurance Broking & Employee Benefit business
  
  
**We will count on you to:**

* Collaborate with cross-functional teams to design, build, integrate, test, and support high-quality AI-enabled solutions that deliver practical business outcomes.
* Harness AI-powered developer tools – including coding assistants such as GitHub Copilot, Claude, and Gemini – and integrate LLM APIs as active accelerators across your day-to-day development workflow, not as an afterthought.
* Apply prompt design and structured interaction techniques to obtain reliable, contextual outputs from generative AI systems for practical engineering and business use cases.
* Verify and validate AI-assisted outputs for correctness, relevance, logic, security, privacy, performance, and fitness for purpose before they are used in production or decision-making.
* Participate in the full lifecycle of AI-enabled solution delivery, including problem framing, design, integration, testing, deployment, monitoring, and support.
* Document solution assumptions, design decisions, guardrails, validation approach, and technical rationale for AI-enabled features and workflows, and support business process improvement initiatives.
* Learn and apply best practices in software engineering, Agile/Scrum, and DevOps within an AI-augmented team.
* Adapt quickly to a fast-changing AI-enabled project environment, demonstrating resilience and a growth mindset.

**What you need to have:**

* B.E. / B. Tech degree (Computer Science, Information Technology, or related engineering discipline).
* Minimum 60% aggregate in Graduation and Post Graduation.
* Will Graduate in 2027 with no active backlogs in any subject.
* Hands-on exposure to at least one modern programming language – Python, JavaScript, Java, C#, or equivalent.
* Strong understanding of AI/ML and generative AI concepts, including LLM behavior, prompting, retrieval, evaluation, limitations, and common failure modes.
* Working knowledge of SQL and/or NoSQL databases
* Demonstrated practical application of AI in at least one project, prototype, workflow, or use case beyond code generation.

**What makes you stand out:**

* Learning Agility – you pick up new tools, patterns, and frameworks fast and apply them independently.
* Critical Thinking – you interrogate AI outputs rather than accepting them at face value; you ask "why" and "so what?"
* Adaptability – you thrive in ambiguous, rapidly changing environments where the best practice of today may be outdated by next quarter.
* Analytical Thinking – you break complex problems into structured components and reason from data and evidence.
* Collaboration – you work effectively across engineering, product, and business teams.
* Digital Literacy – you are comfortable navigating new digital tools and ecosystems with minimal handholding.
* Innovation Mindset – you actively explore new ways to do things better, faster, or with greater impact using AI.
* Prompt Engineering – ability to write, refine, and iterate effective prompts for generative AI tools to produce reliable, contextual outputs.
* LLM Foundations – understanding of how generative AI models work, their probabilistic nature, limitations, and failure modes.
* Code Verification & Quality – disciplined practice of reviewing and validating AI-generated code, not just accepting it.
* Security Hygiene – awareness of security risks in AI-assisted development, including prompt injection, data leakage, and compliance.
* Business Context – ability to align AI outputs with real business objectives and assess return on investment.
* Modern Tech Stacks – exposure to API development, front-end frameworks, server-side programming, DevOps tooling.
* Availability – openness to work in a 24x7 shift environment when required.

**Why join our team:**

* Work at the frontier – you will be part of a team actively integrating AI into real enterprise software, not just experimenting in a sandbox.
* Professional development – we invest in your growth through structured learning, mentoring, and access to Marsh McLennan's global development programmes.
* Inclusive culture – we foster a vibrant, diverse workplace where different perspectives drive better solutions for colleagues, clients, and communities.
* Scale and impact – with operations in 130 countries and 95,000+ colleagues, the systems you contribute to have real global reach.
* Career pathways – AI Native Interns have direct visibility to specialist AI roles, engineering tracks, and cross-functional rotations across the Marsh McLennan enterprise.

**What is an AI Native Intern?**
An AI Native Intern is an engineering professional who understands how to use AI effectively and responsibly to solve practical business and engineering problems, while applying enterprise guardrails, validation, and human judgment.
  
  
At Marsh, this role sits at the Engineering tier of the AI Agility pyramid: professionals who combine strong software development fundamentals with the cognitive readiness and applied AI skills needed to build, integrate, and critically evaluate AI-powered solutions in a live enterprise environment.
  
  
What distinguishes an AI Native Intern is the judgment to know when AI should be used, when it should not, how to validate its outputs, and how to align it to business outcomes, quality, safety, and compliance requirements.
  
  
We are looking for individuals who are measurably ready for AI-enabled work today who can translate emerging AI capabilities into practical, scalable, and well-governed solutions, and who possess the learning agility to keep pace as technology continues to evolve.

**Additional requirement suggestion for stricter filtering:**
Demonstrated practical application of AI in at least one project, prototype, workflow, or use case beyond code generation.
  
  
**Optional to strengthen further**
:...and who can translate emerging AI capabilities into practical, scalable, and well-governed solutions.

title: GDS Cyber - Frontier AI Layered Defense - Senior Manager
description:

**Job Title: EY – Frontier AI Security Lead / Layered Defence Lead – Technology Consulting – Senior Manager**
**About the Role:**
EY is seeking a Senior Manager – Frontier AI Security Lead / Layered Defence Lead to shape, scale, and lead the firm’s capabilities for securing frontier AI systems, generative AI platforms, LLM-powered applications, and agentic or multi-agent architectures. The role will focus on enabling trusted enterprise adoption of advanced AI by designing layered defence strategies that address risks across governance, data, model, agent, application, identity, runtime, and infrastructure layers.
  
  
This leader will define AI security strategy, reference architectures, control patterns, and delivery methodologies that help clients manage emerging risks such as prompt injection, indirect prompt injection, jailbreaks, data leakage, model and RAG poisoning, excessive agency, autonomous tool misuse, system prompt exposure, AI supply chain compromise, and unsafe model or agent behaviour.
  
  
The successful candidate will serve as a trusted advisor to senior client stakeholders and internal leadership, translating frontier AI risk into actionable security programmes, scalable managed capabilities, and market-relevant offerings. The role will also contribute to go-to-market strategy, sales pursuits, solution shaping, and the growth of EY’s AI Security practice.
  
  
The ideal candidate will combine deep cybersecurity, AI, cloud, architecture, and consulting experience with the ability to lead multidisciplinary teams, influence senior stakeholders, and build differentiated capabilities for securing AI at enterprise scale.
  
  
**Layered Defence Scope:**
The role will establish and mature layered defence patterns across the following AI security domains: governance and policy; data, knowledge, and retrieval pipelines; model access and prompt controls; agent planning, memory, tool use, and orchestration; application, API, and integration security; identity, access, secrets, and permissioning; runtime monitoring, telemetry, detection, and response; cloud, platform, infrastructure, and AI supply chain security.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities:**
**Strategy and Practice Leadership**

* Define and drive EY’s Frontier AI Security and Layered Defence strategy across client and enterprise environments.
* Build and scale AI security offerings, delivery methods, reusable assets, accelerators, reference architectures, and control frameworks.
* Lead go-to-market development, sales pursuits, RFP responses, proposals, solution shaping, and commercial growth for AI security engagements.
* Establish a strong AI Security capability and community of practice, including talent development, enablement, knowledge sharing, and innovation priorities.

**Frontier AI Security Architecture**

* Architect secure AI systems across LLM applications, RAG pipelines, AI agents, multi-agent systems, model integrations, APIs, and enterprise platforms.
* Define defence-in-depth patterns across data, model, prompt, agent, application, identity, runtime, and infrastructure layers.
* Embed security into AI engineering lifecycles, including design reviews, threat modelling, secure build standards, MLOps, GenAIOps, DevSecOps, testing, deployment, and continuous monitoring.
* Advise clients on secure adoption of frontier AI capabilities, including high-risk use cases, autonomous workflows, and AI-enabled decision support.

**AI Risk, Red Teaming, and Control Design**

* Lead AI threat modelling and risk assessments for frontier AI use cases, including LLMs, agentic workflows, RAG systems, model providers, and third-party AI components.
* Establish AI red teaming and adversarial testing approaches covering prompt injection, jailbreaks, data exfiltration, model manipulation, tool abuse, excessive agency, and unsafe agent behaviour.
* Define and implement guardrails, policy enforcement, input and output validation, content safety controls, human-in-the-loop checkpoints, permission boundaries, and runtime response mechanisms.
* Align AI security controls to recognised industry frameworks and emerging regulatory expectations, including AI governance, privacy, cybersecurity, and responsible AI requirements.

**Client Advisory and Delivery Leadership**

* Lead large-scale client engagements and advise CxOs, technology leaders, cyber leaders, and risk stakeholders on AI security strategy and operating models.
* Translate complex AI security risks into board-ready narratives, practical control roadmaps, investment priorities, and measurable transformation outcomes.
* Build trusted relationships with clients, partners, ecosystem providers, and internal stakeholders to drive collaboration and business growth.
* Mentor high-performing teams and foster a culture of innovation, automation, responsible AI adoption, and continuous learning.

**Technical Skills and Expertise:**

* Deep expertise in AI security, cybersecurity architecture, cloud security, application security, data protection, privacy, identity, and incident response.
* Strong understanding of frontier AI systems, LLMs, multimodal models, RAG, vector databases, agentic AI, multi-agent orchestration, model context protocols, and AI-enabled automation workflows.
* Proven experience designing layered security architectures for AI systems across governance, data, model, prompt, agent, application, API, identity, runtime, and infrastructure layers.
* Practical knowledge of AI-specific threats including prompt injection, indirect prompt injection, jailbreaks, sensitive information disclosure, system prompt leakage, data and model poisoning, vector and embedding weaknesses, excessive agency, insecure tool use, model theft, and AI supply chain risks.
* Experience with AI red teaming, adversarial testing, safety and security evaluations, model/system documentation, secure RAG assessments, guardrail validation, and control effectiveness testing.
* Hands-on familiarity with Python, SQL, APIs, secure software engineering, MLOps, GenAIOps, CI/CD, observability, telemetry, logging, detection engineering, and response automation.
* Experience with cloud platforms such as Azure, AWS, and GCP, including deployment and protection of AI workloads, model endpoints, data pipelines, secrets, identities, containers, and infrastructure.
* Familiarity with AI engineering frameworks and platforms such as LangChain, LangGraph, AutoGen, semantic orchestration frameworks, vector stores, model gateways, guardrail platforms, and enterprise AI services.
* Ability to align AI security programmes with cybersecurity, technology risk, privacy, responsible AI, and compliance expectations while maintaining practical delivery focus.

* Excellent communication and executive presence, with the ability to engage business, technology, cyber, risk, legal, and compliance stakeholders.

Own the data platform, cloud infrastructure, DevOps foundations and AI/LLM systems that power Responsible AI products. Through reliable pipelines, secure multi-cloud operations and production-grade model integrations, you will improve platform quality, speed and cost control. You will build data systems spanning S3, Redshift, dbt, Airbyte and real-time event processing; operate AWS environments with working knowledge of Azure; and ship RAG, embedding and agentic capabilities over compliance and risk documents. The role combines hands-on implementation with operational accountability for observability, CI/CD, infrastructure as code, Kubernetes, FinOps and LLMOps. You will establish measurable controls for data quality, model performance, hallucination, groundedness, drift, latency and token cost. Success means enterprise-facing systems are reliable, secure, economical and useful, while Responsible AI guardrails protect sensitive information and strengthen trust. This is a full-time, on-site role for an engineer comfortable owning systems end to end in a small, fast-moving environment.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Own S3 data-quality monitoring by emitting custom CloudWatch metrics and alarms, improving anomaly detection and protecting downstream reporting and product decisions.
* Build semantic data models, fine-tune dbt transformations for high-volume real-time events, and implement Airbyte reverse-ETL pipelines that make trusted metrics available across the organisation.
* Optimise Amazon Redshift queries for performance and cost, maintain responsive Metabase or comparable dashboards, and define KPIs that measure recommendation-engine and data-product impact.
* Design and operate highly available, scalable AWS and Azure infrastructure, applying Terraform, Ansible and FinOps controls to improve resilience, security and cloud economics.
* Automate CI/CD through Git or Bitbucket, GitLab CI and Jenkins, embedding unit, integration and static-analysis checks that raise release quality and reduce deployment risk.
* Deploy microservices, databases and front-end applications on Kubernetes, with Prometheus, Grafana, ELK and CloudWatch monitoring APIs, networks, databases and user interfaces.
* Build production LLM features using RAG, embeddings, vector stores, agentic workflows and model APIs, while owning versioning, evaluation, guardrails, auditability and inference operations.

**Essential Skills & Technologies**

* Strong Python, advanced SQL and Bash skills, with production experience in data engineering, cloud or DevOps, and ML engineering across at least two areas.
* Hands-on expertise with dbt, Amazon Redshift, S3, Airbyte, streaming or real-time data, semantic modelling, atomic data tests and Metabase or comparable BI tools.
* Practical AWS capability across core services, IAM, CloudWatch and Bedrock, plus working Azure knowledge; Docker, Kubernetes, Terraform, Ansible, GitLab CI, Jenkins, Prometheus, Grafana and ELK.
* Experience with LLM APIs, RAG, embeddings, vector databases, prompt engineering, model evaluation, deployment monitoring and Responsible AI controls such as PII redaction and prompt-injection defence.
* Ability to integrate foundation models including Anthropic Claude, OpenAI, Azure OpenAI, AWS Bedrock or open-source alternatives, selecting approaches against quality, latency, security and cost requirements.
* Understanding of MLOps or LLMOps, including model and prompt versioning, inference monitoring, token-cost tracking, evaluation harnesses, groundedness, hallucination, drift and output filtering.
* Clear written and verbal communication, strong problem-solving ability, secure engineering habits, effective code reviews and comfort owning systems end to end.

**Additional Plus**

* AWS, Azure, CKA or Terraform certifications, along with Kafka, Kinesis or Spark Streaming experience, can strengthen your ability to operate scalable production platforms.
* Experience fine-tuning or serving open-source models with Hugging Face, vLLM or Ollama can accelerate model experimentation and deployment flexibility.
* Familiarity with Airflow, Dagster or Temporal can improve orchestration of data, model and document-processing workflows.
* Knowledge of ISO/IEC 42001, NIST AI RMF, the EU AI Act, GRC or cybersecurity domains, recommendation systems or A/B testing is valuable.

**What You'll Bring**

* You bring a Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering or a related field, or equivalent practical experience, and two to five years of hands-on production engineering across at least two of data engineering, cloud/DevOps and ML engineering. You can work deeply in Python, advanced SQL and Bash while understanding how data models, infrastructure, applications and AI services behave in production.
* You have built or operated reliable pipelines, cloud environments, CI/CD systems, containers, Kubernetes workloads or model-enabled features, and you can explain the operational and business impact of your decisions. You are comfortable working with AWS and developing working knowledge of Azure, applying security, observability, FinOps and testing rather than treating them as afterthoughts.
* You can evaluate LLM systems pragmatically, protect sensitive data, document trade-offs and collaborate with stakeholders who may not share your technical background. The team needs someone curious, accountable and resourceful: an engineer who can move from investigation to implementation, measure whether a system works, and improve it continuously in a lean environment.

**Why Join Us**

* Own data, cloud and AI systems end to end at an early-stage deep tech company, with the autonomy to shape architecture, engineering standards and operational outcomes.
* Build Responsible AI products used by enterprise clients in third-party risk, GRC and cybersecurity compliance, turning advanced technology into practical trust and governance capabilities.
* Work directly in a lean team where your decisions influence platform reliability, product direction and the quality of systems customers rely on.
* Expand your depth across data engineering, multi-cloud infrastructure, DevOps and AI engineering while learning how to operate technology responsibly in regulated contexts.

**What We Offer**

* Full-time, on-site work five days per week from collaborative offices in Andheri or Thane, with direct engagement across engineering, product and delivery priorities.
* End-to-end ownership across data, cloud, DevOps and AI systems, enabling meaningful technical scope and visible impact on enterprise-facing Responsible AI products.
* Learning budget and support for professional certifications, including opportunities aligned with cloud, infrastructure, security and Responsible AI development.
* A collaborative environment at a Mumbai-based deep tech company where a lean team can see its work directly shape the platform and customer outcomes.

title: Artificial Intelligence Engineer/Research Engineer
description:
**About Trinka AI**

**Trinka AI (**
www.trinka.ai
**)**
is an AI-powered writing assistant designed for academic and technical writing. Built by experts in language and AI, Trinka goes beyond basic grammar checks to improve clarity, tone, and word choice. It corrects complex errors, follows academic style guides, and provides intelligent writing suggestions in real time. Trinka offers tools such as AI-assisted writing, a Paraphraser, AI Studio, Consistency Checks, Technical Checks, Language Quality Checks, Citation Checks, and a Proofread File feature to help users create polished, publication-ready documents. Available as a web app, browser plugin, Word add-in, and desktop app, Trinka also provides enterprise solutions with customization, privacy, and integration options.

**About the team**

We are a bunch of passionate researchers, engineers, product managers, data scientists, and designers who came together to build a product that can revolutionize the way any research-intensive projects are done. Reducing cognitive load and helping people to convert information into knowledge, is at the core of our mission. Our engineering team is building a scalable platform that deals with tons of data, AI processing over the data, and interactions of users from across the globe. We believe research plays a key role in making the world a better place, and we want to make it easy to approach and fun to do!

We are looking for a highly motivated AI / Data Science Engineer with 2–5 years of hands-on experience in building and deploying intelligent systems. The ideal candidate should have strong expertise in Large Language Models (LLMs), model serving (including vLLM), and agent-based architectures. This role involves designing scalable AI solutions, optimizing inference pipelines, and building production-grade AI systems.

**Key Responsibilities:**

* Design, develop, and deploy AI/ML models with a focus on Large Language Models (LLMs)
* Implement and optimize high-performance model serving solutions (e.g., vLLM, FastAPI, Triton)
* Build and maintain agent-based systems (Agentic AI, RAG pipelines, multi-agent workflows)
* Develop scalable data pipelines for preprocessing, embedding generation, and retrieval
* Work on vector databases (FAISS, ChromaDB, etc.) for similarity search and RAG use cases
* Optimize inference latency, throughput, and cost for production deployments
* Collaborate with cross-functional teams to integrate AI solutions into products
* Monitor, debug, and improve deployed AI systems for reliability and performance
* Stay updated with the latest advancements in LLMs, multimodal AI, and agent frameworks

**Required Skills & Qualifications**

* Minimum 1 year of hands-on experience working with Agentic AI systems (multi-agent workflows, autonomous agents, or orchestration frameworks)
* 2–5 years of experience in AI / Data Science / Machine Learning
* Strong proficiency in Python and ML frameworks (PyTorch, TensorFlow, Hugging Face)
* Hands-on experience with Large Language Models (LLMs) and prompt engineering
* Experience with vLLM or similar high-performance inference engines
* Practical knowledge of building agent-based systems (LangChain, CrewAI, custom agents, etc.)
* Experience with Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) architectures
* Familiarity with vector databases (FAISS, ChromaDB, Pinecone, etc.)
* Strong understanding of REST APIs and backend frameworks (FastAPI preferred)
* Experience with Docker, Kubernetes, or cloud deployments (AWS/GCP/Azure)
* Solid understanding of data structures, algorithms, and system design

**Preferred / Good-to-Have Skills**

* Experience with multimodal models (LLaVA, image-to-text, OCR pipelines, etc.)
* Knowledge of distributed systems and GPU optimization techniques
* Experience with streaming inference and real-time AI systems
* Familiarity with model quantization, batching, and memory optimization
* Exposure to open-source LLM ecosystems (OpenRouter, vLLM, TGI, etc.)
* Experience with logging, monitoring, and observability tools
* Knowledge of CI/CD pipelines for ML systems (MLOps)

**Education**

Minimum qualification: B.Tech / B.E. in Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, or a related field

to work directly with business, investment, operations, risk, and technology teams to identify high-value opportunities for applying AI across C
**apital Markets, Wealth Management, and Asset Management**
.

**AI engineering, financial services, product development, and client/business problem solving**
. You will take ambiguous business problems, understand the underlying workflows and data, prototype AI-powered solutions rapidly, and take successful solutions into production.

. You should be comfortable working with senior stakeholders as well as writing production-quality code.

* Identify processes where AI can deliver measurable improvements in productivity, revenue, risk management, client experience, or operational efficiency.

* Client reporting and communication
* Investment proposal generation
* Financial-document intelligence

* Regulatory and compliance workflows
* Trade and post-trade operations
* Risk monitoring and exception management
* Knowledge management and enterprise search

  .

* Establish appropriate evaluation frameworks for LLM and agentic applications.

description:

**Nice to Have**

* Familiarity with engineering tools such as MATLAB, ANSYS, or hardware simulation environments
* Hands-on experience with embedded platforms, FPGAs, or real-time systems

**Why Join Us**

* Work on genuinely cutting-edge AI projects alongside top research labs
* Fully remote and flexible — work on your own schedule, on your own terms

title: Data Architect
description:
**At a Glance: The Story Behind AMINA**

Founded in April 2018 and headquartered in Zug, AMINA Bank is a pioneer in the financial industry. In August 2019, AMINA received a Swiss banking and securities dealer license from FINMA. The broad, vertically integrated spectrum of services, combined with the highest security standards, make AMINA’s value proposition unique.

AMINA operates globally from its regulated hubs in Switzerland, Abu Dhabi, and Hong Kong to offer fiat and crypto services to progressive investors, traditional and crypto-native alike, whether individuals, corporates, or institutions.

CVVC Global Report and CB Insights named AMINA as one of the Top 50 Companies within the blockchain ecosystem. Aite Group awarded AMINA their 2021 Digital Wealth Management Impact Innovation Award in the ‘Digital Startup of the Year’ category, and LinkedIn listed AMINA as one of the Top Startups 2021 in Switzerland. In 2022, AMINA won the Digital Assets Offering or Service at the WealthBriefing Swiss EAM Awards, and the bank was also recognised for its product offering SEBAX and won the Best ETP of the Year award at the Swiss ETF Awards 2022. In 2023, AMINA won the European WealthBriefing Award in the Digital Assets Solution, Fund Manager category.

AMINA India is a wholly owned subsidiary of AMINA Bank AG. AMINA India acts as a virtual extension of the bank supporting activities spanning trading & liquidity management, digital assets research, marketing, investment solutions, risk management, account management, mid/back-office, product management, technology & engineering, IT support, finance and human resources.

**Your Mission (Should You Choose to Accept It)**

We are looking for a hands-on Data Architect with strong expertise in Microsoft Azure, particularly Azure Synapse Analytics and Microsoft Fabric, to design, develop and evolve scalable enterprise data platforms.

This is a design-and-build role, combining data architecture with hands-on data engineering. The candidate will be responsible for translating business and technical requirements into architecture and then actively contributing to the design, development, implementation, optimization and troubleshooting of data solutions.

The role requires strong ownership across data architecture, data modelling, batch and real-time processing, data integration, data quality, performance, security and platform engineering.

You will define data models, integration patterns and engineering standards, guide implementation, and ensure solutions meet business requirements for security, governance, reliability, performance and cost.

**Your AMINA To-Do List**

* Design, develop & maintain end-to-end data solutions across Data Lake, Data Warehouse, Lakehouse and Analytics platforms.
* Design and develop scalable batch, incremental, CDC and real-time/streaming data pipelines.
* Provide deep technical expertise with Hands-on development using Azure Synapse, Azure Data Factory, ADLS Gen2, Event Hubs and Databricks.
* Design & Implement Medallion/Lakehouse architectures, data models, ingestion frameworks and reusable engineering patterns.
* Develop complex SQL, PySpark and data transformation pipelines and perform code reviews.
* Build technical POCs and prototypes and convert validated designs into production-ready solutions
* Troubleshoot and resolve complex data pipeline, performance, data quality and platform issues.
* Optimize data platforms for performance, scalability, reliability and cloud cost.
* Implement monitoring, observability, error handling, recovery and reconciliation mechanisms.
* Implement & Maintain CI/CD, DevOps, security, governance and data engineering standards.
* Maintain architecture decisions, technical documentation and platform roadmaps.
* Evaluate and contribute to adoption of Microsoft Fabric, Databricks and other modern data technologies.
* Work closely with Data Engineering, BI, Cloud, Security and business teams to deliver production-ready data solutions.
* Balance architecture quality, development effort, delivery timelines, performance, reliability and cost.
* Challenge existing designs and propose pragmatic, technology-agnostic solutions based on business and technical requirements.

**Your golden ticket to the AMINA team:**

* Strong hands-on experience in Azure Data Engineering and Data Architecture.
* Deep expertise in Azure Synapse Analytics.
* Strong experience with Azure Data Factory and ADLS Gen2.
* Strong understanding of Data Lake, Data Warehouse and Lakehouse architectures.
* Hands-on experience designing and developing batch, incremental and streaming data pipelines.
* Strong SQL, Python & and data modelling skills.
* Hands-on experience with Spark/PySpark and distributed data processing.
* Experience with large-scale enterprise data platforms and complex data integration.
* Strong understanding of cloud architecture, scalability, performance, reliability and cost optimization.
* Experience with CI/CD, DevOps and production data platform management.
* Ability to design, develop, deploy and troubleshoot data solutions independently.
* Ability to document architecture decisions and guide engineering teams.

**Good to Have**

* Experience with Microsoft Fabric.
* Azure Databricks / Delta Lake.
* Kafka / Confluent / Event Hubs.
* Microsoft Purview.
* Event-driven architecture.
* Power BI and enterprise semantic models.
* Experience with data governance, data quality and observability.
* Experience in financial services, banking or other regulated industries.

**Ideal Candidate**

The ideal candidate is a builder-architect — someone who can understand the requirement, design the architecture, develop the solution, troubleshoot it in production and guide the engineering team. They should be comfortable working hands-on with data pipelines and code while also making architecture-level decisions. They should be able to challenge existing designs constructively and select the right technology based on business requirements, scalability, performance, reliability, security and cost, rather than technology preference.

title: GDS Cyber - CAOE - Staff - AI IT OT Network and Infrastructure Security
description:
At EY, you’ll have the chance to build a career as unique as you are, with the global scale, support, inclusive culture and technology to become the best version of you. And we’re counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all.
  
  
**AI - IT/OT Network & Infrastructure Security – Staff**
**Role Summary**
We are looking for an AI - IT/OT Network & Infrastructure Security Staff professional with solution mindset, who understands & possess knowledge in network security / Infrastructure security concepts, risk and controls concepts, architecture design, transformations that sit at the intersection of enterprise platforms, cybersecurity controls, and AI tools. This role is for a staff professional who should have practical experience in network security engineering, detection engineering, and OT cyber risk reduction, with growing exposure to AI-assisted security operations, prompt engineering, AI-driven anomaly detection, and device behavior analytics.
  
  
This role is part of the Cyber Frontier & AI capability focused on enabling scalable, AI-first cyber defense across enterprise and industrial environments.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Understands design and implementation of network and infrastructure security strategies across enterprise, cloud, and OT environments.
* Drive adoption of Zero Trust, IEC 62443-aligned OT security controls, and advanced segmentation architectures.
* Possess knowledge about deployment and governance of NGFW, NAC, VPN, ZTNA, SASE, DNS security, CASB, and CSPM solutions.
* Incident response and security improvement initiatives to enhance cyber resilience across hybrid infrastructure.
* Possess knowledge & experience on secure remote access, DMZ architecture, PLC security, and cloud network protection.
* Good understanding on AI-assisted IT/OT security architecture and operations, enabling predictive threat monitoring and automated response within industrial environments.
* Understands AI-driven anomaly detection models to identify deviations in OT network traffic, process behaviors, and industrial protocols (e.g., Modbus, DNP3, OPC).
* Build AI-based rule optimization frameworks for IT/OT security controls, improving traffic filtering, segmentation policies, and alert accuracy.
* Leverage AI for OT network traffic optimization, enabling intelligent routing, congestion minimization, and adaptive policy enforcement.
* Implement AI-powered device behavior profiling, establishing baselines for PLCs, HMIs, and IoT/IIoT assets to detect unauthorized or abnormal activities.
* Apply AI in PLC code analysis and review, identifying logic anomalies, misconfigurations, and potential security vulnerabilities in industrial control systems.
* Utilize AI/ML for network threat detection, including intrusion detection, lateral movement analysis, and zero-day attack identification in IT/OT environments.
* Design and optimize prompt engineering strategies to effectively leverage GenAI tools for IT/OT security use cases such as incident investigation, log analysis, and threat intelligence enrichment.
* Enable AI-driven continuous monitoring and predictive risk analytics to enhance IT/OT resilience and reduce operational downtime.
* Build reusable methods, accelerators, reference architectures, and runbooks that strengthen the firm’s AI Network & Infrastructure Security offerings and improve repeatability across sectors and accounts.
* Manage client expectations, delivery scope, solution quality, risks, and technical escalations while coaching teams and enabling long-term client capability through documentation and knowledge transfer.

**Required Qualifications**

* 1–3 years of experience across AI driven Network & Infrastructure security domain, Security architecture, OT security, Zero Trust Security, or related fields.

**Professional understanding & knowledge of-**

* OT security tools (Nozomi, Claroty, Armis, Dragos, Cisco Cyber Vision) and OT vulnerability management.
* XDR, Zero Trust, and regulatory frameworks (IEC 62443, CIS). Hands-on with NGFWs (Palo Alto, Cisco, Fortinet, Azure Firewall) and VMware virtualization security.
* SSE/SASE platforms (Netskope, Zscaler, Akamai) and secure access technologies (VPN, ZTNA, DNS security).
* Multi-vendor security integration across IT, OT, and cloud environments.

**Ideally, you’ll also have**

* Good soft skills i.e. verbal & written communication, technical document writing etc
* Strong interpersonal and customer orientation skills
* Prior experience working in Advisory or Technology Consulting industry
* Knowledge of Information security standards and compliances (ISO 27001, ISO 27017, NIST 800 53, NIST 800-207, CISA, CIS benchmark etc)
* Vendor related certifications (e.g. Zscaler, Nozomi, Netskope, Palo Alto Networks, Cisco & others)

**Why join us**
Join a globally connected cybersecurity practice helping clients protect their network & infra structure security portfolio in an AI-driven world. You will work at the intersection of IT/OT Network , Infrastructure security, and frontier AI — helping shape practical, scalable solutions that reduce risk, enable trust, and support secure business transformation. This is consistent with the internal positioning of the network & infrastructure security practice as technology-enabled, consulting-led, and globally delivered.
  
  
**Typical work environment**

* Global, cross-functional teams
* Mix of advisory, architecture, engineering, and delivery
* Exposure to strategic client programs and market-shaping offerings
* Opportunity to build reusable assets, accelerators, and modernization patterns consistent with a global delivery model

**EY | Building a better working world**
EY exists to build a better working world, helping to create long-term value for clients, people and society and build trust in the capital markets.
  
  
Enabled by data and technology, diverse EY teams in over 150 countries provide trust through assurance and help clients grow, transform and operate.
  
  
Working across assurance, consulting, law, strategy, tax and transactions, EY teams ask better questions to find new answers for the complex issues facing our world today.

title: SME – Credit Decisioning & Business Rule Engine (BRE)
description:
**About the Company**

SME Credit Decisioning and Business Rule Engine Vymo transforms how financial institutions manage their distribution networks and collections operations. Our AI-powered DMS and CMS platform serves 350,000+ users across 70+ global financial enterprises, enabling banks and insurers to optimize performance across their distribution channels, and empowering banks to drive operational excellence in collections.

Why Global Leaders Choose Vymo Vymo partners with financial institutions through a comprehensive solution that combines deep domain expertise with cutting-edge technology. Our platform's human-centric design, coupled with enterprise-grade scalability and AI-powered intelligence, delivers measurable business outcomes while ensuring high user adoption and engagement.

* Recognition & Trust
* Backed by $45M+ funding from Peak XV partners (formerly Sequoia), Emergence Capital, and Bertelsmann Investments.
* Trusted by leading global financial institutions including Berkshire Hathaway, AIA, AXA, SBI Life, HDFC Bank, Aditya Birla Capital, Tata AIA, ABSLI and many more!
* Recognized by Celent in their 2024 Distribution Management Solutions report, with an Advanced Functionality ranking.
* Featured in Gartner's Market Guide for Sales Engagement Applications and recognized as a "Strong Performer" in Forrester's Sales Engagement Wave Report.
* Microsoft 'AI for All' award winner for innovation in artificial intelligence

**About the Role**

The Role Credit decisions at scale — whether a loan gets approved, at what rate, under what conditions — are governed by business rule engines and decision frameworks that have been refined over decades inside banks, NBFCs, and risk analytics firms. Vymo's agentic AI systems interact with, augment, and in some cases replace components of these decisioning frameworks. Building the right system requires someone who understands how business rule engines actually work: how rules are authored, versioned, tested, and deployed; how credit policy translates into decision logic; where the standard engines fall short and where manual override is still the norm. That is this role. You are the person who sits between a client's risk team and Vymo's product team — making sure that what is being built reflects how credit decisioning actually works in a regulated Indian financial institution, not how a software team imagines it works. You will carry domain knowledge from the BRE layer through to the underwriting policy and credit risk framework that sits above it. The crux of this role: you know enough about credit decisioning and BRE architecture to know which questions, asked in which sequence, reveal how a client's decision engine actually works — and what Vymo needs to build to sit alongside it or replace it.

**Responsibilities**

What You Will Do

* Client Discovery — Decode the Decision Engine
* Diagnose architectural realities and data flows by asking targeted questions that reveal system dependencies, latencies, and integration requirements.
* Translate discovered logic gaps into actionable visual maps and precise engineering specifications for the product team.
* Product Requirements — Translate Decisioning Logic Into What to Build
* Translate credit decisioning and Business Rule Engine (BRE) logic into precise product specifications for Vymo's agentic layer, defining routing, rule execution, and human-in-the-loop interventions.
* Validate technical assumptions against BFSI deployment cycles while mapping major BRE platforms (e.g., SAS, Experian, FICO) to ensure architectural accuracy.
* GTM Support — Lend Credibility to the Technical Sales Conversation
* Partner with sales teams in high-stakes sessions to provide deep architectural credibility and handle advanced technical inquiries regarding BRE and decisioning systems.
* Act as a trusted advisor to client architects and risk heads, auditing technical proposals and developing GTM assets that address platform constraints and regulatory governance.
* Industry Intelligence — Track How Decisioning Is Evolving
* Track RBI regulatory changes—including the Model Risk Management Framework (MRMF) and AI explainability rules—alongside Indian BRE market trends to anticipate compliance demands.
* Build a strong network of industry experts to validate core architecture choices and feed real-world market insights directly into the product roadmap.

**Qualifications**

What You will Bring

* Experience & Fluency
* Domain Background: Operational depth in credit decisioning across key sectors—whether coming from BRE vendors (SAS, FICO, Experian), bank/NBFC credit risk teams, underwriting operations, risk consulting, or credit bureaus.
* BRE & Risk Architecture: Deep understanding of Business Rule Engine (BRE) architectures, rule authoring, champion-challenger frameworks, scorecard calibration, and baseline risk concepts ($PD/LGD/EAD$).
* Origination & Integration Landscape: Practical knowledge of Loan Origination System (LOS) integration patterns, core platform configurations (e.g., PowerCurve, Blaze Advisor), and performance metrics like Straight Through Processing (STP) rates.
* Regulatory & Compliance Context: Familiarity with RBI guidelines regarding algorithmic credit decisions, model risk management, explainability requirements, and cloud data localization constraints.

**Required Skills**

Mindset & Core Traits

* Architectural Inquiry: Driven by deep curiosity about how entire systems fit together, possessing the precise sequence of targeted questions that uncover how a client’s engine actually operates beneath the documentation.
* Skeptical Practitioner: Operates with a healthy skepticism of stated architectures; validates system realities by analyzing deployment logs, rule histories, and exception reports rather than relying solely on official diagrams.
* Policy-to-Logic Translation: Seamlessly bridges the gap between high-level credit policy language and structured, actionable rule engine engineering specifications.
* Grounded Intellectual Humility: Explicitly understands the boundaries of personal technical knowledge, prioritizing accurate discovery and domain-expert networking over making unverified assumptions.

title: Senior Applied AI Engineer — LLM Reasoning & Evaluation
description:
About the Project

The Ops Layer is building HELIOS, an AI-powered operational intelligence platform that transforms organizational questionnaire responses into structured, evidence-grounded decision intelligence.

HELIOS analyzes information from multiple organizational stakeholders to identify recurring operational decisions, decision ownership, authority boundaries, escalation conditions, dependencies, and governance gaps.

An initial implementation already exists, including data ingestion, LLM processing, claim extraction, semantic normalization, evidence lineage, and structured Excel output.

We are looking for an experienced Applied AI Engineer to evaluate, strengthen, and advance the existing system, with particular emphasis on 
**semantic reasoning accuracy, reliability, and production readiness**
.

Key Responsibilities

* Review and assess the existing AI processing architecture and Python backend.
* Improve extraction and interpretation of source-grounded organizational claims.
* Develop reliable recurring-decision identification and semantic consolidation.
* Distinguish operational decisions from activities, recommendations, inputs, prerequisites, and authority statements.
* Preserve decision ownership, approval boundaries, conditions, numerical thresholds, and exception paths.
* Prevent hallucinated decisions, unsupported authority assignments, and incorrect organizational diagnoses.
* Implement evidence-validation mechanisms and source-level traceability.
* Build automated LLM evaluation, regression testing, and quality assurance frameworks.
* Optimize pipeline performance, reliability, and deployment stability.
* Maintain clear technical documentation and reproducible development environments.

Required Technical Experience

* Strong Python backend engineering, preferably FastAPI and SQLAlchemy.
* Hands-on experience developing and deploying LLM-powered applications.
* Experience with OpenAI, Anthropic, or comparable commercial LLM APIs.
* Structured extraction, JSON schemas, function calling, and output validation.
* Semantic classification, entity resolution, and information normalization.
* Multi-stage AI workflows and reasoning pipelines.
* LLM evaluation frameworks, gold-standard datasets, and regression testing.
* Experience with relational databases, REST APIs, Git, and cloud deployment.
* Ability to investigate complex semantic failures systematically.

Strongly Preferred

3. Preserve decision-specific inputs, conditions, thresholds, and dependencies.
4. Distinguish formal authority, actual practice, exceptions, and unresolved information.
5. Ensure every published interpretation is supported by traceable evidence.
6. Produce consistent, independently verifiable results across diverse organizational scenarios.

The first milestone will focus on evaluating and improving the existing reasoning engine against predefined acceptance tests.

**We prioritize demonstrated semantic correctness over pipeline complexity or feature volume.**

Ideal Candidate

An engineer who has built AI systems where accuracy, traceability, and consistent interpretation are critical.

We value strong engineering judgment, transparent communication, reliable delivery practices, and the ability to identify root causes rather than repeatedly patch individual outputs.

Candidates should be comfortable taking technical ownership of an existing codebase and proposing architectural improvements when justified.

title: AI Staff Engineer
description:
**About StavPay**
StavPay is a SaaS platform that automates accounts payable workflows, payment processing, and financial operations for hedge funds, private equity firms, fund administrators, and family offices. The platform handles invoice capture, approval routing, vendor management, multi-entity accounting, and payment execution.
  
  
We are entering a new phase of product development: embedding AI and agentic capabilities directly into our platform to transform how financial operations teams work. This is the most important technical initiative at StavPay, and this role will lead it.
  
  
**About The Role**
We are hiring a Staff Engineer to own the architecture, design, and delivery of AI-powered and Agentic features across StavPay. This is not an ML research role - it is a product engineering role for someone who can take large language models, tool-use patterns, and agentic frameworks and ship them as reliable, production-grade features that financial operations teams depend on daily. This role works alongside Lead Engineers who run the engineering team’s day-to-day delivery; the Staff Engineer owns architecture, patterns, and technical direction across both AI features and the broader platform.
  
  
You will define how AI is integrated into StavPay: which workflows become agentic, how models interact with our domain data, how we build trust and safety into autonomous financial operations, and how we evolve the platform architecture to support these capabilities at scale.
  
  
This is a high-autonomy, high-impact role. You will work across the full stack - from prompt engineering and model orchestration to API design, data pipelines, and frontend integration - and collaborate closely with product, design, and domain experts to ship features that meaningfully change how our clients operate.
  
  
**Tech Stack & Environment**
You will work across the following stack. Deep expertise in every layer is not required — but you should be comfortable navigating a polyglot codebase and making architectural decisions that span these technologies.
  
  
**Cloud**
Microsoft Azure (App Services, Functions, Storage, Service Bus, Key Vault)
  
  
**Backend**
existing platform services in C# (Core)/ .NET/ Python
  
  
**Frontend**
Angular / TypeScript
  
  
**Database**
SQL Server
  
  
**Architecture**
Containerized microservices (Docker, Azure Container Apps / AKS) and Azure App Services
  
  
**DevOps**
Azure DevOps (CI/CD pipelines, repos, boards)
  
  
**AI Tooling**
Claude, Codex CLI and Cursor for agentic development workflows
  
  
**Integrations**
MCP servers, REST APIs, payment rails (NACHA, ISO 20022, SWIFT), accounting system APIs
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**
**Agentic Architecture & System Design**

* Design and build the core agentic infrastructure for StavPay: agent orchestration, tool-use frameworks, memory/context management, and guardrails for autonomous financial workflows.
* Define the architecture for how LLMs interact with StavPay’s domain model: invoices/contracts/purchase orders, approvals, vendor records, payment instructions, payment orchestration, accounting entries - safely and reliably.
* Build and maintain MCP (Model Context Protocol) servers and integrations that expose StavPay’s capabilities as tools for AI agents and external AI platforms used by our clients.
* Design patterns for human-in-the-loop oversight, approval gates, and escalation paths in agentic financial workflows.

**AI Feature Development**

* Lead development of AI-powered product features: intelligent invoice processing, automated approval routing, anomaly detection, natural-language querying of financial data, and predictive cash-flow analysis.
* Build and iterate on prompt chains, retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) pipelines, and multi-step agent workflows tailored to financial operations.
* Implement evaluation frameworks: automated testing for AI outputs, regression detection, quality scoring, and production monitoring for model-driven features.
* Own the integration layer between LLM providers (Anthropic, OpenAI, etc.) and StavPay’s backend-model selection, fallback strategies, cost optimization, and latency management.

**Technical Leadership**

* Set technical direction for AI/agentic development across the engineering team. Write RFCs, architectural decision records, and technical specifications.
* Mentor engineers on AI integration patterns, prompt engineering, evaluation methodology, and safe deployment of model-driven features.
* Establish engineering standards for AI features: testing practices, monitoring, incident response, and responsible AI guidelines specific to financial data.
* Drive build-vs-buy decisions for AI tooling, frameworks, and infrastructure. Evaluate emerging tools and frameworks and make pragmatic adoption recommendations.

**Cross-Functional Collaboration**

* Partner with product management to identify high-value AI use cases, scope MVPs, and define success criteria grounded in client outcomes.
* Work with the implementation team to understand client workflows and pain points that AI can address.
* Collaborate with security and compliance to ensure AI features meet regulatory requirements for financial data handling, auditability, and data privacy.

**Required Qualifications**

* 8+ years of professional software engineering experience, with significant time spent building production systems at scale.
* 3+ years of hands-on experience building AI/ML-powered product features, including at least 1+ year shipping LLM-powered or agentic features into production (not research prototypes, but shipped software that real users depend on).
* Deep experience with LLM integration: prompt engineering, function/tool calling, RAG architecture, agent orchestration, and evaluation frameworks.
* Strong software engineering fundamentals: system design, API design, data modeling, distributed systems, and production operations.
* Strong proficiency in Python. Working knowledge of TypeScript is a plus.
* Track record of leading technical initiatives that span multiple teams or systems, with strong written communication (RFCs, design docs, ADRs).
* Demonstrated ability to work with ambiguity — translating broad product goals into concrete technical plans and shipping iteratively.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Strongly preferred: Hands-on experience building MCP (Model Context Protocol) servers or production integrations. Stavtar runs MCP-first agentic infrastructure, and this experience is one of the most differentiating signals for this role.
* Experience with at least one modern AI/agent framework (LangChain, LlamaIndex, Anthropic tool use, OpenAI Assistants, or similar) and a clear-eyed view of their trade-offs.
* Familiarity with SQL and relational databases.
* Comfort reading and integrating with C# / .NET services. You will design how AI features interact with the existing platform, but you will not be expected to build primarily in C#.
* Domain experience in FinTech, payments, accounting automation, fund administration, or financial operations.
* Experience with AI-assisted development tools (Claude Code, Cursor, Copilot) and a philosophy for how they change engineering workflows.
* Background in building trust and safety systems for AI: content filtering, output validation, human-in-the-loop patterns, and audit logging for autonomous actions.
* Experience with Azure cloud services, SQL Server, or Azure DevOps.
* Familiarity with financial data formats and integrations: NACHA, ISO 20022, SWIFT, or accounting system APIs (QuickBooks, NetSuite, Sage).
* Prior experience at a Staff/Principal level or as a founding/early engineer at a startup where you shaped technical direction.

**What You Might Ship in the First Year**
The specifics will depend on where you see the highest leverage, but examples of the kind of work we envision:
  
  

* Agentic AP assistant - an AI agent that can process incoming invoices, match them to POs, and contracts, route for approval, flag anomalies, and draft payment instructions with human confirmation.
* Agentic Contract assistant - an AI agent that can process incoming contracts, extract key terms and obligations as structured metadata, and route for human-in-the-loop review.
* Natural-language financial queries - a conversational interface that lets controllers ask questions about payables, cash positions, and vendor history without building reports.
* MCP integration layer – Build/Enhance MCP servers that expose StavPay’s core capabilities to external AI tools, enabling clients to interact with StavPay from Claude, Copilot, or their own agentic systems.
* Intelligent onboarding - AI-powered data extraction and mapping that accelerates client onboarding from weeks to days.
* Evaluation and monitoring infrastructure - automated testing, quality scoring, and production observability for every AI-driven feature.

**How We Measure Success**

* Shipped AI features that clients actively use and that measurably reduce manual work in financial operations workflows.
* Reliable agentic systems - autonomous workflows that operate safely within defined guardrails, with low error rates and clear audit trails.
* Engineering velocity - the team ships AI features faster over time because of the infrastructure, patterns, and tooling you establish.
* Technical credibility - you are the person engineering, product, and leadership turn to for AI/agentic technical decisions, and your judgment is consistently sound.
* Team capability growth - engineers across the team are more effective at building AI-powered features because of your mentorship and the standards you set.

**Why This Role Matters**
Financial operations is one of the highest-value domains for AI, it is structured, repetitive, high-stakes, and ripe for intelligent automation. But building AI for finance requires more than model access. It requires deep product thinking, rigorous engineering, and respect for the fact that these systems move real money.
  
  
This role is the technical cornerstone of StavPay’s AI strategy. You will not be bolting AI onto an existing product - you will be fundamentally reshaping how the product works, and how our clients work, by bringing agentic intelligence into every layer of financial operations.
  
  
If you want to build AI systems that matter, at a company where you can see the direct impact of your work on real businesses, this is the role.
